claims.text: POL-NS-01 makes the no-show fee chargeable only if the driver carries all four limbs, and limb (b) requires the gps_trace itself to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the arrival event. It does not. The trace's derived arrival block records qualifying_fix_count 0 for this STANDARD pickup, and no fix in the trace reports an accuracy_m at all, so under POL-NS-02 not one of the eight fixes is an admissible in-radius fix. A conjunctive test with an unproven limb fails and the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01. I disclose that EV-GPS-00901 is IMPAIRED for admissibility (issue codes LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, weight_multiplier 0.6). The point I press is not a positive fact the trace asserts but the absence of the qualifying fix the driver needs, and the burden of that limb sits on the driver, not on the rider.

On POL-NS-02's own terms, where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The 15-minute window before the 08:51:00 cancellation runs from 08:36:00, and the derived arrival block shows 0 qualifying fixes and 0 fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius that pass the 25 m accuracy filter across it. The rider should get the fee back in full. I again disclose that EV-GPS-00901 is IMPAIRED (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD, weight 0.6); POL-NS-02 does not require the rider to prove the driver's absence, only that no qualifying fix establishes presence, so the discount does not disturb the point.

Independently, POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full whenever the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. For this STANDARD pickup the minimum is 300 seconds; the derived arrival block records the longest qualifying run at 0.0 seconds against a 300-second shortfall, with 0 qualifying fixes. The driver's 08:43:00 marker and the 08:51:00 cancellation span eight minutes of wall-clock, but none of that is qualifying dwell, because dwell runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and there is none. The full refund follows. EV-GPS-00901 is IMPAIRED (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD, weight 0.6) and I disclose it.

The driver cannot shore up the dwell by accumulating separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i): that limb requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose active window covers the waiting period, and whose type is KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. The bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-00901-01, is MISSING with no payload and weight 0.0, and the derived arrival block records limb (i) as unavailable for the reason 'advisory_missing.' The 300-second minimum therefore stands unmodified, and no interval-summing is available to the driver.

The amount itself is defective. Under POL-NS-01 and fee_schedule.resolution_rule the chargeable fee is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), that is SGD 4.00; the ledger charged SGD 5.00. That mismatch engages POL-NS-08(d), which makes the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line an integrity defect, and it independently requires the charge to come down by at least the SGD 1.00 excess regardless of how the arrival question is resolved. I disclose that EV-FARE-00901 is IMPAIRED (issue code PARTIAL_RECORD, weight_multiplier 0.75); the fee-schedule figures it is measured against come from the policy, not from the artifact, so the discount does not disturb the comparison.

I do not press POL-NS-04 and I say so rather than stretch it. Limb (a) requires the chat_log to show a locating or coordinating message from the rider, and the six-entry log EV-CHAT-00901 carries only driver messages and the system cancellation notice; the rider posted nothing. Limb (b) fails too, because the driver did place an in-app call (CALL-00901-001 at 08:47:05, unanswered) before terminating the trip. My case therefore rests entirely on the arrival and dwell limbs of POL-NS-01, which do not depend on rider messages or rider presence.

If the Judge concludes that the deciding fact - whether the driver arrived and held position - rests solely on EV-GPS-00901, then that artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(b): its own gaps exceed 120 seconds inside the waiting window, the waiting window holds only four fixes, and the rider_track is omitted entirely. It is the sole carrier of that fact and its weight is 0.6, so under POL-NS-08 the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09, and under POL-GEN-02(2) a deciding fact carried by an artifact at 0.6 sits below the 0.70 floor and escalates automatically. Escalation holds the disputed SGD 5.00 rather than leaving it collected, which is the floor of the rider's entitlement on this record, not a reason to let the charge stand.

claims.text: The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRIP-2026-09945 at 08:43:00, which satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (a) on the face of the source's own record.

That arrival marker was auto-confirmed from a GPS measurement — the source's own driver_arrived event reads 'Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed.' — so this is not a false-arrival marker of the kind POL-NS-05 corrects, and the waiting clock runs from 08:43:00.

On the source's own timestamps the driver was at the pickup from the 08:43:00 arrival to the 08:51:00 cancellation — 480 seconds, comfortably above the 300-second STANDARD-zone minimum — and the complete six-entry chat log corroborates him holding at the lobby area across that entire window.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is met: the trip records no boarding event (started_at is null) and was terminated by the driver at 08:51:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, at or after the required dwell elapsed. The driver had also placed an in-app call at 08:47:05 (22 seconds, unanswered) and sent four messages before cancelling.

POL-NS-04 — the rider's principal refund route — requires at limb (a) at least one locating or coordinating message from the rider during the waiting window. The chat log holds six entries and not one is from the rider, so limb (a) fails and the clause cannot exonerate the rider.

The rider's presence is not established either. No rider track was supplied (rider_presence.available is false, rider_fix_count 0), so under POL-NS-04 limb (c) the test is UNDECIDABLE and neutral — neither satisfied nor failed — and no finding that the rider stood at the lobby may be drawn from it. The trace is impaired (weight 0.6; LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD).

The GPS trace is IMPAIRED — weight 0.6, issue codes LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, with a 240-second gap and only four fixes across the waiting window — and not one of its fixes reports an accuracy figure, so under POL-NS-02 every fix counts as evidence of neither presence nor absence. A trace silent on the driver's position cannot establish that he was absent from the geofence, and under POL-NS-08 an artifact impaired on these limbs cannot alone support a ruling against the party it disfavours.

The trace's own derived driver_track records a minimum distance to the pickup pin of 0.0 m and includes 0 km/h among its distinct speeds — the driver did reach the handset-recorded pickup point, contradicting the rider's assertion that the driver never showed up. The trace is impaired (weight 0.6) and I rely on it for this corroboration only, not as the sole basis of any ruling.

POL-NS-08(a)'s clock-skew limb is not engaged: the 08:43:00 arrival marker coincides with a GPS fix timestamp, so the event-to-fix matching this category depends on is sound and the arrival time may be relied on.

POL-NS-08's escalation-on-solely-impaired-evidence sentence is not engaged: the two facts that decide this dispute — the 08:43:00 arrival and the wait through to 08:51:00 — are carried by the COMPLETE, weight-1.0 trip record and chat log, not by the impaired trace alone.

POL-NS-02's full-refund limb fires only where in-radius fixes were tested and none qualified. Here the pre-pass could measure no fix at all, because none reports an accuracy value; reading 'no qualifying fix' to mean 'no accuracy metadata' would convert a data gap into proof the driver was never there — the very inference POL-NS-02 forbids when it calls such fixes evidence of neither presence nor absence.

The derived in-geofence dwell of 0 seconds (qualifying_fix_count 0) is an artifact of the accuracy filter rejecting every fix for want of a reported accuracy, not a finding that the driver left the pickup. POL-NS-06's shortfall arithmetic cannot be run on a trace in which no fix is measurable, so it cannot carry the rider's refund either. The trace is impaired (weight 0.6).

The anti-farming condition that withholds compensation under POL-NS-07 is not established on this record: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is null, nowhere near the 4-or-more threshold the clause requires, so the withholding limb never fires and the driver is owed 80 percent of the chargeable fee.','evidence_ids':['EV-DPROF-00901','EV-FARE-00901'],'clause_ids':['POL-NS-07'],'asserted_weight':1.0}

The fare ledger's 5.00 cancellation line does not reconcile with the 4.00 that fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for a STANDARD-zone RYDE_X trip, which is a POL-NS-08(d) defect in that artifact (weight 0.75; PARTIAL_RECORD). It goes to the amount of any chargeable fee at most, and it does not disturb the finding that the driver arrived and waited — which is what the rider's claim actually contests.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver, together. This dispute turns on one question: was the driver actually inside the pickup geofence at Tiong Bahru Plaza, holding position for the required five minutes, before he cancelled and the SGD 5.00 no-show fee was applied? I cannot decide that question on this record, and the policy sends it to a human reviewer.

WHAT IS ESTABLISHED. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00901, full weight 1.0) contains a driver 'arrived' event at 08:43:00, no boarding event, and a driver-initiated cancellation at 08:51:00 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are therefore met (driver claims 1 and 4 accepted). The chat log (EV-CHAT-00901, full weight 1.0) contains only driver messages and the system notice; the rider posted nothing and did not answer the driver's 08:47:05 in-app call. POL-NS-04 consequently cannot exonerate the rider — limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message from the rider and there is none, and limb (b) fails because a call was placed before termination (driver claim 5 accepted; rider claim 6 is right to abandon this route). Rider presence is undecidable under POL-NS-04(c) because no rider track was supplied (driver claim 6 accepted).

WHAT CANNOT BE DECIDED. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) must be proved from the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00901). That artifact is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue codes LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD — sampling gaps of up to 240 seconds inside the waiting window, fewer than six fixes across it, the rider track omitted, and no horizontal-accuracy figure on any of its eight fixes. Under POL-NS-02 a fix reporting no accuracy is evidence of neither presence nor absence, so not one fix establishes arrival. The test those limbs require therefore could not be run: limbs (b) and (c) are UNDECIDED over the waiting window, not failed. That disposes of the rider's refund arguments — the POL-NS-02 full-refund limb (claims 1 and 2) and the POL-NS-06 shortfall arithmetic (claim 3) both read 'no qualifying fix' as proof the driver never arrived, and a data gap cannot be read that way. It equally disposes of the driver's contrary argument (claims 3 and 10): the trip record's arrival marker is auto-confirmed from the same GPS measurement, so marker and trace are one carrier and not two, and the chat log is the driver's own account, which may not stand in for a measurement the test never admitted.

CONSEQUENCE. The fact that decides this dispute — the driver's in-geofence presence and dwell — is carried only by an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(b). POL-NS-08 therefore caps any monetary ruling at PARTIAL_REFUND and escalates the case under POL-NS-09; POL-NS-09(e) makes that escalation terminal, and POL-NS-09(a) applies independently because confidence is capped at 0.6, below the 0.70 floor.
